list.title: WebGL
list.description: An innovative experience can increase your perceived brand value and, consequently, your conversions. We help you throughout the process, from concept to implementation.

list.title: E–Commerce
list.description: A headless e–commerce means a faster site, better scalability and more conversions. If a full stack solution can’t give your customer the experience your business wants, we help you. Improving loading times, increasing your SEO scores and, above all, providing a fully personalized experience to your customers. We work with Shopify, Square, WooCommerce, etc.

list.title: Native Apps
list.description: Fully native apps using React Native. React Native is being used in thousands of apps, but it's likely you've already used it in apps like Facebook, Skype, Outlook or Discord.

list.title: Maintenance
list.description: We aim to build long term relationships with our clients. We do not ship and forget. We offer year based packages to help you manage your site once it has been published. From updates, to downsides or new features. You are covered.

list.title: In-House Support
list.description: We collaborate individually, as freelancer, with other studios and agencies on a project basis. We aim to build open collaborations to reach mutual ambitions. Always adapted to the contractor schedule. Working one-on-one with us to build your project from the ground up. Specially efficient if you work with Nuxt/Vue, Next/React, Vanilla JS and WebGL.

about.title: About
about.hint: Over a decade of experience delivering award-winning interactive experiences for leading brands and companies worldwide.
about.detail: I'm Christian MacMillan, I was born in Mallorca in 1990 and have always been fascinated by design and tech. I studied a BS in Software Engineering, but soon I realized I was drawn towards more creative ways of implementing software. Three years ago, after living in different cities and working in some of the most creative and recongnized agencies, like B-Reel or Vasava, I decided to go solo. After years of freelancing, I grow into a full-service development studio to meet with my clients needs. We are a remote team designed to scale on a project basis. Easygoing, open minded, easy to collaborate with, and always willing to learn new skills in different areas.

collaborator.title: Our sister studio
collaborator.description: Any good web production needs a solid UX & UI design partner. For this reason, we’ve been partnering up with Xavier Cussó and our extended team of creative and technologists for 8 years now. A proven approach that allows us to scale on-demand to match any brief in a highly-optimised process.

testimonials.quote: I had the privilege to work with Christian in many projects, and I can say it has always been a pleasure to have him as part of the team. As a reliable and collaborative Tech Lead, he is very keen to push for the quality on every single detail, working fully integrated with the Creative team, and adding a lot to the final output.
testimonials.credit: Rodrigo Alberini—Director of Operations @ Feels Like

testimonials.quote: The life of my business would end without my website. I trust Christian with my life. In addition to world-class developer skills, he brings a level of insight, empathy, and collaborative-ness that makes him the perfect partner on our projects.

When quality meets deadlines! He has a great eye for detail, making it a pleasure for designers to work with him. He consistently delivers solid projects with the latest tech and features, always on time, ensuring the smoothest workflow and maximum efficiency!

Working with Christian is always a pleasure. He is very detail-oriented and ensures that the design is elevated with high-quality animations. His keen eye for design consistently brings our projects to life, and communication with him is effortless. He takes the time to thoroughly understand the project and asks the right questions, which is incredibly important and helpful. Collaborating with him has always been a smooth and enjoyable experience.
testimonials.credit: Esteban Piacentino—Tech Director @ Domestic Data Streamers

testimonials.quote: I highly recommend Christian for any development project. He is a super talented developer with a strong focus on problem-solving and possesses an exceptional eye for design and animation. His unique combination of technical expertise and creative skills ensures high-quality, innovative solutions.

Working with Christian means happy clients. He’s an all-round developer with problem-solving and leadership skills. The cherry on top is his great eye for design and animation, a hard-to-find quality in a dev that always help our projects shine. Always on my team!
testimonials.credit: Xavier Cussó—Design Director @ Xavier Cussó Studio
